name: KUT Fortnightly Issue
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — the fortnightly drawing issue. (1) Revision leak check FAILS the run when any sheet's STING revision stamp disagrees with the revision it is actually issued at (a draft or stale value would otherwise reach the title block, the file names and ACC). (2) Issue Sheets for Revision issues the open draft revision to every sheet carrying its clouds, refusing a revision/suitability pair ISO 19650 does not allow (P needs S0-S7, C needs A/B/CR); unattended it never prompts and never issues a revision with no clouded sheet, and on success it updates linked deliverables (revision from the Revit issue, IssuedDate), the document register and proposes matching issues as RESPONDED (never closes them). (3) Title-block revision sync writes the ISSUED revision, numbered per sheet. (4) Sheet compliance. (5) Scheduled Export Centre jobs produce the issue set — the sheet PDFs/DWGs. THE DRAWINGS REACH ACC HERE: tick 'Upload to ACC' on the job's export profile and each sheet is uploaded to its suitability's CDE folder, ledgered (an identical file is never re-sent) and pairing-checked. The step fails when nothing was exported or any job did not run. (6) ACC Publish packages the information-management data (BEP, issue/document registers, transmittal log, COBie, health reports) into a bundle — NOT the drawings — and (7) uploads the bundle THIS run built (an earlier cycle's bundle is refused). Both ACC steps fail the run on error, and neither runs after an earlier step failed. (8) MIDP drift report compares planned dates against the IssuedDate just recorded — it asks for the MIDP CSV, so it runs only in an attended run and is optional. Needs %APPDATA%/Planscape/acc_credentials.json and _BIM_COORD/acc/acc_settings.json (cdeFolders) for the ACC steps.

steps.label: 1. Revision leak check — fail if any sheet stamp disagrees with its issued revision
2. Issue the open draft revision to its clouded sheets (ISO 19650 revision/suitability gate; updates deliverables, register, issues)
3. Title-block revision sync (issued revision, numbered per sheet)
5. Export the issue set (due Export Centre scheduled jobs; a profile with 'Upload to ACC' sends each sheet to ACC)
6. Package the information-management data (registers, COBie, reports) into the ACC bundle — not the drawings
7. Upload the bundle this run built to ACC (CDE folder by suitability)
8. MIDP drift report — planned vs actual issue dates (attended runs: asks for the MIDP CSV)
